text: This run looked at the coding-agents page for a technical evaluator in GCCs & IT services to help more developers open the API docs. The audit found that the hero (the saved copy from 2026-11-15) does not do its job on A1-audience, A2-value, A3-proof, and A4-cta. The writer tried three angles: Variant A focused on jurisdiction, Variant B on recovery and testing, and Variant C on control and routing. Jev and Judge 2 decided that all three variants were near misses that failed Gate 2 because A7-checklist-item-1 fell. A person approved Variant B. The sandbox results are synthetic, so the simulated visitors show that the method works, not that a variant wins.
